```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    
    /*** creating IStructure 'SL_CatalogItem' ***/
    var sL_CatalogItem = eSpace.CreateStructure("SL_CatalogItem");
    sL_CatalogItem.Description = "One catalog row, as the service layer returns it";
    var id = sL_CatalogItem.CreateAttribute("Id");
    id.DataType = eSpace.Model.LongIntegerType;
}
```
